title: Service-dependent test evidence is explicit
expected: A local service can be an explicitly declared integration-test dependency.
Tests using live external systems disclose weaker reproducibility and cannot be called hermetic by default.

cases.name: service-unavailable
cases.change: Stop the service before the integration action.
cases.expect: Record failed/unavailable integration evidence; do not silently skip.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
